title: It Depends, and What Would Have Been
label: ch:sa-it-depends-and-what-would-have-been
canDo: I can say what something depends on (tat samayādhīnam) and what would have happened (yadi samayaḥ abhaviṣyat, tarhi aham āgamiṣyam), and tell a short trip in six connected lines.
